$comment: Per-image options for scripts/products/images.mjs, decided by looking at the result on the contact sheets (.shots/catalog). Key = catalogue image key. Options: cutout false (keep opaque), holes true (cut out closed windows of pure background colour) or [[x, y], …] (only the windows at these points, shares of the picture: white print elsewhere stays), extend true (the object touches the frame of a plain canvas: extend it, then cut out), clean true (transparent source: drop a baked shadow or glow and stray specks), pad <share> (padding instead of 0.06), trim false (opaque photo keeps its whole frame), crop [left, top, right, bottom] (shares of the original cut off first). Every entry says why.

donkey-kong-bananza--1.why: The cover touches the top and bottom of its white 2000 px square canvas, so it was left as a white square; extending the canvas lets the pack shot be cut out like the other Switch 2 covers.

kirby-air-riders--1.why: Cover on a white square canvas it touches at the top and bottom (same Nintendo template as donkey-kong-bananza--1).

hyperx-cloud-iii-s-wireless--1.why: All-black headset: the white seen between headband and suspension band and behind the cable loop is background (it stayed as white patches); nothing on the product is white.

hyperx-cloud-iii-s-wireless--2.why: All-black headset and accessories: the closed white windows (headband, cable coils) are background.

hyperx-cloud-iii-s-wireless--3.why: Black and red headset: the white between the bands and behind the cable is background.

hyperx-cloud-iii-s-wireless--6.why: Black and blue headset: the white between the bands and behind the cable is background.

pulse-3d--4.why: Grey camouflage headset: the white inside the headband arch is background; the product has no pure white.

joy-con-2--2.why: The straps touch the frame and their loops enclose background; the Joy-Con 2 and straps are dark grey and black.

joy-con-2--4.why: The straps touch the frame and their loops enclose background; the Joy-Con 2 and straps are dark grey and black.

joy-con-2--5.why: Strap loops enclose background; the Joy-Con 2 and straps are dark grey and black.

nintendo-switch-2-zelda-40th-anniversary.why: Strap loops enclose background; the green and gold Joy-Con and black straps have no pure white.

joy-con-2-wheel--3.why: The wheels touch the frame of a mostly empty white square and their openings show background; wheels are red, blue and black.

nintendo-switch-2-carrying-case--3.why: The zip-pull loops enclose background; the case is black, brown and gold.

nintendo-switch-2-carrying-case--4.why: The zip-pull loops enclose background; the case is black and green.

nintendo-switch-2-camera--3.why: The cable loop encloses background; the camera and cable are black.

nintendo-switch-oled--5.why: The dock touches the frame of a white canvas; extended, the console with neon Joy-Con cuts out cleanly (checked on both floors).

nintendo-switch-oled--2.why: The screen's top corner touches the top of the white 1280 px canvas, so it was left as a white box (a white plate in the dark well, QA 2026-11-13); extended, the white set cuts out with a firm outline — screen, dock and grip — checked on both floors and in corner zooms.

nintendo-switch-oled--4.why: The neon Joy-Con touch the left and right edges of the white 1200×675 canvas, so it was left as a white box; extended, the console cuts out in one piece with a firm outline (checked on both floors and in corner zooms).

nintendo-switch-lite--1.why: The console's ends touch the left and right edges of the white 1200×675 canvas, so it was left as a white box (a white plate in the dark well, QA 2026-11-13); extended, it cuts out in one piece with a firm outline, the light shoulder buttons included (checked on both floors and in corner zooms).

nintendo-switch-lite--2.why: The back of the turquoise console touches the left and right edges of its white canvas (same Nintendo template as nintendo-switch-lite--1); extended, it cuts out cleanly, shoulder buttons included.

nintendo-switch-lite--4.why: The yellow console touches the left and right edges of its white canvas (same Nintendo template as nintendo-switch-lite--1); extended, it cuts out cleanly.

nintendo-switch-lite--5.why: The coral console touches the left and right edges of its white canvas (same Nintendo template as nintendo-switch-lite--1); extended, it cuts out cleanly.

steam-deck-lcd--1.why: The transparent render carries a broad baked shadow that reached the picture's edge (a faint rectangle on the light floor) and a shadow slab under the device; the stage draws its own shadow.

nintendo-switch-2-mario-kart-world-bundl.why: The transparent render has a white floor glow under the box that shows as a white smudge on the dark floor.

playstation-portal--2.why: Two stray opaque specks at the right edge of the 3840 px canvas widened the picture and pushed the device off centre.

playstation-5--3.why: Sony's transparent render carries a white floor glow under the DualSense and the console's base, a white smudge on the dark floor; cleaned, the console and controller stand on the stage's own shadow.

nintendo-switch-2-carrying-case--5.why: The photo is pillarboxed: 150 px white bars on both sides of a dark 900 px photo.

seagate-storage-expansion-card--4.why: White background shows in a slanted 131–142 px strip right of the console; cropped just inside it (148 px) so no white sliver remains.

nintendo-switch-2--4.why: The tabletop scene touches the left and right edges of its white 2000 px square (console and Joy-Con are whole, just touching), so it stayed a white box in the dark well (QA 2026-11-13). Extended, it cuts out cleanly; the one closed window of background — the triangle inside the kickstand, centred at (0.084, 0.586) — is opened by its point, because holes true would also open the white «2 / NINTENDO SWITCH» on the screen (checked on magenta, both floors and a zoom of the stand).

playstation-5-slim--5.why: An opaque white 900 px photo sits inside a 2000 px transparent canvas, so it was drawn as a hard white rectangle; cropped to the photo it is treated as an opaque photo on white (framed, rounded).

playstation-store-gift-card--1.why: The gift card's face (Sony's card faceplate, 1600×1067): a printed card fills its own rectangle by design, like box art — the storefront draws it as a card (84% of the well, --r-xs corners, design v2 §7.3 and §7.6), so there is no background to cut out.
